integrity: The proof is analytic, with an exact quadratic derivative factorization, and a standalone standard-library numerical checker for supplementary spot checks. Independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Steady one-box mixing with fixed upper-layer oxygen, oxygen-independent baseline consumption and an assumed Hill-p mixing-stimulated demand law. The formula is physically interpreted only at positive deep-oxygen equilibria. The sources do not calibrate these parameters, and the result does not establish field tipping points, transient behavior, or general response-law robustness.
title: Sharp cooperative-consumption threshold for reentrant oxygen loss under vertical mixing
